editor.movement: Drag the title bar or use Move aside; position is retained across component changes and saved locally. Native window reservations are relaxed for configurable HUD surfaces.
editor.resize: Drag left/right or top/bottom handles to change width or height independently, or the corner to change both. Nearby visible-window and screen edges snap the dragged dimensions with cyan guides; Shift bypasses snapping and Layout provides a switch. One gesture is one Undo step. Grid reflow favors complete rows and preserves icon proportions. Fixed widgets expose separate axis scales; circular maps remain circular.
editor.grids: Shared geometry supports aspect-based reflow or explicit rows and columns, including 3x2. Menu, spells and items expose width/height, rows/columns and a reflow switch. Existing saved layouts without these fields remain compatible.
editor.resource_icons: Optional vector health, Ether, food, action, load and XP emblems. Enabled in the five concepts and independently selectable per resource strip.
editor.selection: Circle hit testing follows its ornament and actual curve shapes. Transparent corners do not intercept neighboring controls. All eight curves are selectable directly or through the compact Left/Right selector.
editor.history: Undo and Redo retain up to 40 editing steps. One drag is one step. Chat appearance is included in snapshots.
editor.restore_default: HUD settings and the editor expose Restore default for Current and options 1–5. It restores layout, visibility, colors and chat appearance while retaining custom presets, drafts, recipients and feeds. Undo and Cancel can recover edited layouts. Disabled for custom presets.
editor.custom_presets: Up to 24 named custom layouts. Save as new or Update, then Done & save. Cancel restores the opening snapshot.
editor.visibility: Each component and each original menu icon can be independently enabled or disabled.
editor.colors: Background, border and text per component; center fill and each curved meter have independent colors. Each resource has an editable bar color shared by its tinted emblem and live player summary.
editor.frames: Independent HUD background and border switches, including clock and compass. Gapless connected panels remove shared border segments on both sides; partial joins retain exposed outside edges. Native chat backdrop opacity and idle fade remain authoritative.
editor.border_designs: Plain, beveled and ornate HUD trim. Layered highlights, corner details and circular studs echo the concept's brass frame and follow the outside edges of docked panels.
editor.compass_corners: Transparent, filled when docked, or always filled. Filled compass panels participate in the same shared frame drawing as the clock. Automatic fill recognizes attached children and screen pins.
editor.minimap_frames: Match map, circle or rectangle. Circular frames clip the map and preserve round geometry through resizing, unequal saved axis scales and docking; the editor highlights their circular outline. Native map shape controls update matching frames.
editor.resource_order: Resource meters Options provides ordered visibility, earlier/later arrows and color controls. Disabled meters retain their order; the full order and palette persist in custom presets.
editor.quick_counts: Quick spell count (1–12) and quick item count (1–8) remain visible on every editor tab for the selected bar and update its existing live controls.
editor.clock_modes: Dial, digital, or both, using the original live clock widgets. Disabled clocks retain their chosen mode. Digital-only clocks remain enabled when saving.
editor.party_summary: Optional detailed self summary shows initials, leader status, health, Ether, food, action and load with live values and palette-matched icons. Include yourself controls the summary and native self row together; other party rows and actions remain native.

resource_circle.curve_geometry: Each curve has an editable radius offset, thickness, start angle and sweep. Drag radially to adjust radius; drag its end handle to adjust thickness. Attached button rows trim the adjacent curves to avoid covering slots.

docking.screen_edges: Explicit side/corner pins and drag previews reach the actual game-window edge without a forced margin.
docking.alignment: Start, center, end or stretch; optional extension to the remaining screen edge. Connected sizes and offsets are resolved before placement.
docking.interaction: Drag a docked component to move its group; Alt-drag or Detach releases just that component. Nearby edges show a snap preview before dropping. Dock sockets follow each border's visible radius, including after resizing.

editor.chat: Original conversation and system controls, histories, composer, destinations, drafts, logs, URLs, combined mode and shortcuts are retained.
other_controls: Resource labels, values, visibility and strip orientation
Player card visibility and secondary values

editor.minimap_annotations: Optional live map title above the map, all/north-only/hidden directions, letter or camera-relative north arrowhead, and -48 to 120 local-pixel spacing from the radius. An independent label-plaque switch uses the map HUD background/border toggles and palette. Native annotations return in Current HUD.
editor.circle_connections: Visible ornament sockets are used for both ends of a dock. A circle can attach to a meter on any of its four sides; backgrounds join below the ornament and only the shared panel-border segment is removed. Wide meters use a neck no wider than the circle. Existing bar-to-circle connections remain supported. Perpendicular panels that meet around the ornament fill their enclosed corners. Background patches are disjoint to retain the selected opacity; border clipping handles overlapping connectors as well as adjacent panels. Lone bars and disabled supporting backgrounds retain open shoulders.
editor.party_escape: Escape skips the persistent roster but still closes other extension windows. Explicit party close/toggle and session-wide cleanup retain their behavior.
editor.blank_panel: Selectable, movable, resizable empty HUD surface with the standard color, frame, opacity and docking controls. Optional full-screen height and automatic hiding while skill statistics are visible. Height dragging releases full-height fill. Gameplay clicks pass through it. The Heritage factory default keeps its full-height backdrop visible behind enabled statistics. Background exclusions avoid painting translucent panel backgrounds twice.
editor.resource_fit: Every enabled resource has measured space for its icon, label, value and bar. Narrow strips add rows; thin XP-strip dimensions expand when ordinary meters or labels are enabled. Bottom docks resolve after the fit, keeping all entries inside the viewport. Tall cells center the entire content group together.
editor.frame_opacity: Look exposes background and border opacity separately from RGB colors. Enabling an inherited zero-alpha frame or choosing a new frame color makes it visible. Old enabled panel backgrounds inherited from transparent XP strips migrate once; the frame_alpha_version marker preserves subsequently explicit zero opacity.
editor.builtin_edits: Each built-in retains its own modified layout while switching. Done & save persists all remembered options; Restore default resets only the selected built-in. Undo/Redo and Cancel include the remembered layouts. Older profiles migrate their current active working layout.
editor.heritage_statistics: Enabled by default. Stretch docking matches the research/clock/compass column width and fills all available height below quick access with no forced spacer. The logo and both quick bars share the same rail width. Shorter viewports reduce the statistics height without overlapping quick bars. The blank rail stays visible both with and without statistics; automatic hiding remains optional. Native item scrolling stays available without a reserved scrollbar gutter changing the docked width.
editor.slot_borders: Independent Match HUD, None, Beveled or Ornate icon borders on spells and items, with an editable trim color. Floating window frames can stay disabled. Node2D trim has no input handling or layout minimum size, and remains visible across empty, disabled and cooldown item states. Current HUD clears custom trim.
editor.icon_opacity: Main quick-slot icon opacity defaults to 1.0; unavailable magic/technique opacity is an optional multiplier that also defaults to 1.0. Look exposes both controls. Presentation changes never enable an item or bypass casting restrictions. Undo, reset and saved layouts retain these settings; missing fields in older profiles default to full visibility.
